messages:
Maya Chen: FYI received SkyBridge invoice 2026-09-1187 for $6,300 but there's no PO on it and the vendor charged our infra cost center instead of ENG-Platform. Attached PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/skybridge-2026-09-1187.pdf :eyes:

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: SkyBridge 2026-09-1187, amount $6,300, vendor_id=SB-4432. No PO detected. Recommended action: HOLD until PO match or approval. (AP ticket #AP-8821)

Jamal Patel: Noted. Vendor usually includes PO in description but omitted here. Can we match to PO pattern `PO-<TEAM>-<YEAR>-<SEQ>`? Do we have an ENG PO for Sept?

Priya Rao: This was a short-term storage burst for the streaming feature tests — we asked SkyBridge to keep it under trial but apparently ran over. Cost center should be `ENG-PLATFORM` (GL 5602). No PO created at the time because it was within the trial allowance.

Liam O'Connor: We should not pay until we either get a retrospective PO or a written dispute/credit from SkyBridge. Action items: 1) AP to request credit for $6,300 or provide invoice with PO; 2) if vendor insists, route to VP Eng for approval to accept without PO (requires GL exception).

Maya Chen: I'll ping SkyBridge AP now. Drafting: "Per our policy, invoices require PO match; please either issue a corrected invoice with PO `PO-ENG-2026-###` or confirm a credit note."

Jamal Patel: If we need a retrospective PO, use temporary PO format I created last quarter: `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-009`. Finance will treat it as exception and code to `ENG-PLATFORM` but we'll need VP sign-off.

Priya Rao: Okay to escalate to VP Eng (Anika) for sign-off if AP refuses credit. This is time-sensitive, we need the storage backdated to Sept 14-20 for cost allocation.

invoices-bot: AP ticket updated: AP-8821 -> status: vendor_contacted. Added note: "Requested corrected invoice or credit note. If vendor cannot provide, route AP-8821 to finance-approvals for VP sign-off."

Liam O'Connor: I'll hold payment and mark as "disputed" in accounting until we have either a corrected invoice or VP approval. Please add any vendor responses to AP-8821.

Maya Chen: Vendor replied via email: "We can issue credit for $4,750 and bill the remainder as usage on a new PO." They attached a proposed credit memo. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/skybridge-credit-1187.pdf

Jamal Patel: Hm partial credit. That implies disputed line items. Can Procurement get the usage logs from Eng to confirm the billed quantity? Priya?

Priya Rao: Sending export now. `s3://redwood-logs/streaming/tests/usage/2026-09/09-14-20.csv` — shows 1.9TB billed, vendor charged 3.2TB. Will attach to AP-8821.

Liam O'Connor: Good, with usage evidence we can push for full credit or correct invoice. If vendor holds firm on partial credit, route to Anika for approval to accept remainder.

Maya Chen: Recording decision path: (a) await vendor corrected invoice or full credit; (b) if partial credit only, escalate to VP Eng for exception; (c) if no resolution in 7 business days, escalate to Legal. Added to AP-8821 timeline. :white_check_mark:

Priya Rao: Thanks — I've attached the usage CSV to the ticket and CC'd Anika in the request for faster review.

Maya Chen: I'll update this thread once AP confirms next steps or VP signs off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
